cohort: The study included two cohorts of infants with FGR from a large maternity hospital: a historical cohort born from 2010 to 2012 and a contemporary cohort born from 2020 to 2022.
finding: Despite improvements in certain socioeconomic factors, increased prenatal care, and a decrease in prematurity, the global incidence of FGR remained constant at approximately 5.13% across the two time periods.
mod_finding: The incidence of Cesarean sections significantly increased in the contemporary cohort (59.2%) compared to the historical cohort (49.9%).
